After more than a decade of silence, one of the country’s most iconic Pride events is making a blazing comeback.

Mentorque Productions president and chief executive officer Bryan Dy officially announces the return of White Party Manila, unveiling its 2026 edition titled “White Party Manila: Reignite.” The event marks the revival of the once-legendary celebration after 12 years of “hibernation,” promising a grand, high-energy night for the LGBTQIA+ community and its allies.

The event aims to merge fashion, music, and advocacy into one immersive spectacle where “fashion meets rave, and style becomes a collective force.” Organizers say the comeback is more than just a party—it is a symbolic rebirth of love, freedom, and pride where “every color and every story is equal.”

White Party Manila: Reignite is scheduled on June 27, 2026 at the World Trade Center in Pasay City, positioning itself as one of the biggest highlights of the country’s Pride Month celebrations.

The event also carries a strong advocacy component. Organizers announce that the party will be held for the benefit of LoveYourself, a nonprofit organization known for promoting self-love, sexual health awareness, and community care among Filipinos, particularly within the LGBTQIA+ sector.

“With purpose at its core, we are reigniting the fire for a cause,” the announcement states, emphasizing that the event will combine entertainment with meaningful community impact.

With its return, White Party Manila aims to once again gather thousands of revelers dressed in white, uniting under a shared celebration of diversity, equality, and pride. Organizers are expected to reveal more details, including ambassadors, performers, and partners, in the coming months.

#radarph #WhitePartyManila

🚨 ਮੋਗਾ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਟ੍ਰੈਫਿਕ ਅਡਵਾਇਜ਼ਰੀ 🚨

ਕਿੱਲੀ ਚਹਿਲ (ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਮੋਗਾ) ਵਿਖੇ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ “ਯੁੱਧ ਨਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਵਿਰੁੱਧ ਮੁਹਿੰਮ 2.0” ਸਮਾਗਮ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਆਵਾਜਾਈ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਚਾਰੂ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਰੱਖਣ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਮੋਗਾ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਟ੍ਰੈਫਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ। ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਦਿਸ਼ਾਵਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਲਈ ਬਦਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਰੂਟ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਸੁਵਿਧਾ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਪਵੇ।
📢 ਸਮੂਹ ਜਨਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਅਪੀਲ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਰੂਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਫਿਕ ਨਿਰਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹਿਯੋਗ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਵੇ।
📞 ਟ੍ਰੈਫਿਕ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲਈ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਕਰੋ:
97800-01879 | 96568-96568
👉 ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਸਹਿਯੋਗ — ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਚਾਰੂ ਆਵਾਜਾਈ ਦੀ ਗਾਰੰਟੀ।

🚨 Moga Police Issues Important Traffic Advisory 🚨

In view of the large gathering expected during the “War Against Drugs Campaign 2.0” event at Killi Chahal (District Moga), Moga Police has implemented special traffic arrangements to ensure smooth, safe, and hassle-free movement of vehicles. Diversion routes have been designated for traffic coming from different directions to prevent congestion and inconvenience to the public.
📢 The general public is requested to strictly follow the notified diversion routes and cooperate with traffic officials on duty.
📞 For traffic-related assistance, contact:
97800-01879 | 96568-96568

👉 Your cooperation ensures safe and seamless travel for everyone.

#TodayInHistory 

 USS Maine explodes in 1898 at Havana harbour killing 266 American sailors,   and fueled U.S. public outrage against Spain through yellow journalism, despite no conclusive evidence of sabotage.

Modern investigations, including a 1976 U.S. Navy study, attribute the blast to an internal coal bunker fire igniting ammunition magazines, debunking Spanish involvement but leaving false flag theories unsubstantiated.

The incident propelled the Spanish-American War, enabling U.S. acquisition of Cuba, Puerto Rico, and the Philippines, marking America's shift to global imperialism.
